Subject: Multi-region/data residency architecture review — deep-dive request

Hi Tessa / Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. We'd like a technical deep-dive covering our multi-region deployment plan (EU/US/APAC) and how Redwood Inference would handle data residency, routing, and fallback policies. The ask from our side:

- 90-minute architecture review with platform + security + infra leads
- A short runbook/rollout checklist (what we deliver vs. you provide)
- Time to discuss fallback behavior across regions and audit log retention

Constraints: our APAC team prefers local morning (08:00–11:00 JST), while US infra prefers PTO-friendly afternoon (15:00–18:00 PDT). EU security can do mid-day CET (13:00–16:00 CET).

Can you propose concrete slots during the week of Aug 17–21? If splitting into two sessions (arch + compliance) makes sense, we're open to that — would prefer to limit execs' time if possible. I can share our SOC 2 contact and a short document with current residency requirements (attached).

Thanks,
Rajiv Menon
Head of Platform, Acme Financial
rajiv@acme-fin.com

Hi Rajiv — thanks, this is helpful.

We can definitely run a 90-minute session, but given the timezone spread we recommend two options:

Option A — single combined deep-dive (90m):
- Thu Aug 19, 2026 | 16:00–17:30 PDT / 19:00–20:30 EDT / 00:00–01:30 BST (Fri) / 08:00–09:30 JST (Fri)

Option B — split into two focused sessions:
- Arch deep-dive (60m): Fri Aug 20, 2026 | 08:00–09:00 PDT / 16:00–17:00 BST / 00:00–01:00 JST (Sat) — more APAC-friendly
- Compliance breakout (30m): Mon Aug 23, 2026 | 10:00–10:30 PDT / 18:00–18:30 BST / 02:00–02:30 JST (Tue)

I've attached a first-pass agenda (mr-arch-agenda-v1.pdf) and a short residency scope spreadsheet. Can you confirm which option works for the core attendees? If we're splitting, we'll have Karhik join the architecture session and Marissa will lead the compliance breakout.

Also: do you want us to record? We'll provide a shared Google Doc for notes and the runbook checklist after the session.

Thanks,

Tessa — quick note from the engineering side.

I agree we should keep the heavy architectural topics in a single 60–75 minute session with platform and infra leads; compliance/SOC2 questions often work better in a shorter follow-up (30 min). Our dedicated infra lead (Ravi) is out on Aug 19 and 20 afternoon (US), so the combined slot you proposed for Thu Aug 19 at 16:00 PDT would miss him. Karhik, can you confirm availability for either Fri Aug 20 morning slot or Mon Aug 23 compliance breakout?

If we split:
- Architecture (60–75m) — Fri Aug 20, 08:00–09:15 PDT (works for APAC morning)
- Compliance (30m) — Mon Aug 23, 10:00–10:30 PDT

Also recommend we surface two pieces in the agenda:
1) KV cache / prefix caching implications across regions
2) Model variant routing & graceful fallback (what happens to active sessions when we route to a lower-tier model)

I'll add those bullets to the agenda and upload a short diagram.

-Marissa
